Create ONE exceptionally high-quality ORIGINAL fantastical beauty illustration, using the attached USER-MADE artwork solely as a quality/painting reference for large complex luminous irises, extremely detailed eyelashes and fine hair, soft elegant anime-beauty face gradients, tiny sharp glossy reflections on cheek/nose/lips, rich jeweled local light, densely layered fantasy atmosphere. Do NOT copy its girl, blonde hair, witch hat, lantern, pose, magazine composition, pumpkins, lettering, or signature. No lanterns, hats, pumpkins, horns, moons, wings, bubbles, rings, text or UI. Full distinct original identity, clothes, scene and composition. Do not make a photographic woman with small ordinary eyes. Do NOT turn the skin into glass or broken rainbow facets. Not flat cel shading, not a generic plastic CG doll.
Original artwork: an adult female fantasy clock artisan with shoulder-length deep aubergine layered hair, a single long side lock, large luminous amber-violet anime irises with an intensely dark pupil, delicate almond upper lids and dense fine eyelashes, subtle warm smile. A fully covered high-collared dark indigo fitted coat with fine satin panels, a small amber enamel clasp and embroidered cuffs. Around her, an elaborate original midnight clockwork conservatory recedes through staggered open arches and enormous tree-like glass timepiece structures; multiple detailed brasswork layers at coherent depths. The actual lit mechanisms and amber-violet window panes illuminate this single space. An original half-assembled delicate clock device rests on the table, supported rather than floating.
Beauty finish is a refined digital anime/semi-real illustration: greatly stylized elegant anime eye geometry, crystal-clear multispectral iris paint with many tiny sharp reflections INSIDE the iris, very small perfect white glints and saturated amber/violet color strata, not two ordinary small green eyeballs. Very soft smooth carefully painted face shading, luminous skin with minute sharp cheek/nose and lip highlights and small violet bounced light at jaw and ear; keep broad face midtones clean so the face remains dominant. Fine natural-looking hair accents layered over organized painted locks, bright thin curves reflecting amber and violet, deep hair interior shadows. Fine cool-violet/amber rim light must continue from hair to face edges, neck, wrists, fingers and sleeves. Thin internal reflected-color glazes and localized luminous specks enrich actual surfaces; NO broad hard rainbow stripe dividing the face. Deep connected indigo shadows contrasted with brilliant small jewel-like local glints, rich translucent depth, not a sea of white bloom. The surrounding architecture and glass clockwork have extraordinary resolved layered detail, glints and reflections, but the brighter irises/face remain the central focus. Fantastic material atmosphere and light from scene share the same color and falloff with the person. No floating particle-only glow. Highly polished finished art.
